blocks.goal: Introduce a dedicated helper class to contain HTML cleaning and validation logic currently implemented inline in Jsoup, so the Jsoup class can delegate and be smaller/cohesive.

ops.details: Create a new class org.jsoup.JsoupCleaner with public static methods that encapsulate the cleaning and validation behaviors currently implemented inside Jsoup: clean(String, String, Safelist), clean(String, Safelist), clean(String, String, Safelist, Document.OutputSettings), and isValid(String, Safelist). The implementations mirror the existing logic in Jsoup: handle DummyUri substitution when safelist.preserveRelativeLinks() and then parse the body fragment, call new Cleaner(safelist).clean(...) or .isValidBodyHtml(...) as appropriate, and apply output settings when provided. Place the new class in package org.jsoup and add necessary imports (org.jsoup.nodes.Document, org.jsoup.safety.Cleaner, org.jsoup.safety.Safelist, org.jsoup.Parser, org.jsoup.internal.SharedConstants.DummyUri). This class is a pure facade/helper and does not change public APIs of Jsoup.

blocks.goal: Refactor Jsoup to delegate cleaning/validation responsibilities to the new JsoupCleaner facade so Jsoup's class size and responsibility are reduced without changing its public API.

ops.details: Add an import for org.jsoup.JsoupCleaner in Jsoup.java so the class can call the new facade methods. Keep all existing imports intact.

Change the bodies of the Jsoup public static methods related to cleaning and validation to delegate to JsoupCleaner. Specifically: replace the implementation of clean(String bodyHtml, String baseUri, Safelist safelist) to return JsoupCleaner.clean(bodyHtml, baseUri, safelist); replace clean(String bodyHtml, Safelist safelist) to return JsoupCleaner.clean(bodyHtml, safelist); replace clean(String bodyHtml, String baseUri, Safelist safelist, Document.OutputSettings outputSettings) to return JsoupCleaner.clean(bodyHtml, baseUri, safelist, outputSettings); and replace isValid(String bodyHtml, Safelist safelist) to return JsoupCleaner.isValid(bodyHtml, safelist). Do not change method signatures or visibility. This preserves the public API while moving implementation out of Jsoup.
